description: Source code for process management in an Odoo/OpenERP module, defining classes for processes, nodes, conditions, transitions, and actions with methods for searching, graph generation, and copying processes.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: Custom environment class providing context with object and user references.

classes.name: process_process
classes.description: Represents a process with methods for searching by model, generating process graphs, and copying processes.

classes.name: process_node
classes.description: Represents a node within a process, including copying data functionality.

classes.name: process_node_condition
classes.description: Represents a condition associated with a process node.

classes.name: process_transition
classes.description: Represents a transition between process nodes, including associated actions and roles.

classes.name: process_transition_action
classes.description: Represents an action associated with a process transition, including copying data functionality.

methods.name: search_by_model
methods.description: Searches for processes related to a specific model.

methods.name: graph_get
methods.description: Generates a graphical representation of a process with nodes and transitions.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Deep copies an entire process, including nodes and transitions.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Copies data for process nodes and transitions, used in deep copying processes.
